title: NHI Runtime Decision-Rights Manifest
description: Manifest declaring the identity provenance and permitted actions for a non-human identity. Companion to OWASP SPVS V1.3.7 work on NHI runtime decision-rights.

nhi_id.description: Unique identifier for this NHI manifest.

audience.description: Required token audience. The gate refuses tokens with a different audience.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of the token at the moment of the gate check. Tokens older than this are refused.

trust_anchor.description: Optional. Identifier of the trust anchor (root CA, JWKS endpoint, SPIFFE trust domain root) that the issuer must chain to.

permitted_actions.description: Actions this NHI is permitted to invoke. References to the action-class manifest by action name.

action.description: Action identifier. Matches an entry in the action-class manifest.

class.description: Maximum action class this NHI is permitted to invoke.
